page_rectangle_boundary: Host supplies rectangle origin [0,0]; native PDFium provides the loaded page width and height used for its right/bottom edges.
source_geometry_boundary: Host generator supplies MediaBox/CropBox/Rotate/UserUnit and asymmetric source vector; pinned native PdfiumImpl parses dimensions/rotation from the actual generated PDF.
matrix_composition_boundary: Pinned native Composer executes addBodyText and BodyTextPDFWriter through RectF Offset/Scale into a host Drawing::DrawObject sink; a separate pinned native PdfiumImpl GetObjectMatrix/GetObjectPosition call consumes that captured rect. No full DrawObject-to-AddImage dispatch, FPDF insertion, content generation, serialization, or pixels are captured.

cases.native_path: PdfiumImpl Open/LoadPage -> Composer addBodyText/BodyTextPDFWriter -> RectF Offset/Scale -> separate PdfiumImpl::GetObjectMatrix/GetObjectPosition
host_boundaries: WPage dimensions and one DrawnText marker are host supplied to native Composer
The native BodyTextPDFWriter scale field is observed at the real function entry; the independently computed expected ratio is host-derived
Drawing::DrawObject is a host sink; its captured native rect is passed to the separate native PDFium matrix helpers
cases.boundary: PDFium loads the generated source PDF through native PdfiumImpl; its loaded dimensions and rotation feed actual Composer addBodyText and BodyTextPDFWriter calls. A read-only hook observes the scale field passed to the real BodyTextPDFWriter::WriteBodyText entry. Native Base RectF operations transform the host synthetic marker before the host DrawObject sink. The actual PdfiumImpl AddImage matrix/position callees execute on that rect, but Drawing::DrawObject to AddImage, FPDF insertion, content generation, serialization and pixels do not execute.
cases.interpretation: The source PDF parser reports CropBox dimensions 150x115, rotated to 115x150; the factor UserUnit=2 is not present in those dimensions. The paired offset-CropBox case shifts native PDFium matrix and position translations by its origin delta. Composer transforms only the supplied note marker and imported page rectangle; the final native PDFium helper call is separate from Drawing::DrawObject.
